item.title: SHR 25.09: From ICE and tax cuts to commandments and privacy
item.description: The Feb. 27, 2026, issue of Statehouse Report provides updates on how state legislators want to push more cooperation of local police agencies with federal ICE officials and how they want the Ten Commandments in schools. In a commentary, Andy Brack urges Gov. Henry McMaster to veto a college athletics bill that would upturn the state’s Freedom of Information Act. The post SHR 25.09: From ICE and tax cuts to commandments and privacy appeared first on Charleston City Paper.

item.title: S.C. House wants schools to post Ten Commandments
item.description: The S.C. House on Wednesday passed a bill requiring state public schools, including colleges, to post the Ten Commandments of the Judeo-Christin tradition in all Palmetto State classrooms. The post S.C. House wants schools to post Ten Commandments appeared first on Charleston City Paper.
